title: feed.recommendations.reset v1 payload
description: An account reset its recommendations in My Algorithm (Tara Intelligence WP 8.4-B2). Ids and a timestamp only. Emitted by feed in the transaction that sets the preference's reset_at, behind INTEL_EMIT_R4_EVENTS (default on). Consumer: post (reel_view rows before reset_at are ignored for the reels seen order).
